text: {"lessons":["A large gain in Stock A justified trimming some exposure, but selling at a profit alone does not prove the timing was right; I should weigh its outlook and portfolio concentration.","The decline after Period 9 is a reminder that gains can reverse, so I should review risk and diversification without reacting to one month's move.","My long history of infrequent trading supports patience, but I should make deliberate, goal-based decisions rather than treating inaction as a strategy by itself."]}
